slides.h1: If the job is still open, tailor the CV and apply on their page
slides.sub: Ten India career pages, checked against each employer's own hiring system through 24 September 2026.
slides.caption: If you are applying to Citibank or Wells Fargo, tailor the CV and submit it on their careers page. If you are applying to AB InBev or Palo Alto Networks, check the hiring system still has the role before that evening goes into the CV.

We read ten global employers' India career pages against their own hiring systems, through 24 September 2026. A role counts as closed once the hiring system stops serving it. Four employers sit under 15%. Four sit over 29%.

slides.sub: Citibank pulls a closed listing in 2.6 days. Tailor the CV and submit on their page.
slides.caption: Citibank pulls a closed listing in 2.6 days on average. Amazon's closed ads in this cut come down the same day. A posting on these pages, on the day you open it, is a role the hiring system is still serving.

slides.sub: AB InBev still advertises 69.6% of roles its hiring system has closed.
slides.caption: AB InBev still advertises 69.6% of the roles its hiring system has closed, 23 roles watched. Okta's closed ads stay up 42.4 days. Palo Alto Networks sits at 50.0% of 44.

slides.h1: Big Data. AI and machine learning. Security management.
slides.sub: The Forum's India page, Future of Jobs 2025. An open ad is the career page that still serves the role this week.
slides.caption:
The World Economic Forum's survey asks employers what they expect by 2030. On the India page, the fastest-growing role names are Big Data Specialists, AI and Machine Learning Specialists, and Security Management Specialists. The tailored CV follows the posting that is open.
